title: decode_body_value returns NoHeaders for bad body_range
description: In mime-tree/src/decode.rs, when body_range is out of bounds the function returns Err(ParseError::NoHeaders). The NoHeaders variant means 'no RFC 5322 headers found', not 'byte range is invalid'. A caller receiving this error at 2am will be confused — the error message says 'input contains no RFC 5322 headers' but the real problem is an invalid byte range. A new ParseError variant (e.g. InvalidByteRange) or a different existing variant should be used so the error message is accurate.
close_reason: duplicate of MIME-72l.20 (same wrong error variant)
